auth.registration.title: Dala i-akhawunti yakho
auth.registration.subtitle:
Joyina i-AWA futhi uqale
uhambo lwakho unokuthula.
auth.registration.hint: Okungenani izinhlamvu ezi-8, uhlamvu olukhulu, inombolo, nophawu olukhethekile
auth.forgotPassword.title: Ukhohlwe iphasiwedi?
auth.forgotPassword.subtitle:
Ungakhathazeki. Faka ikheli lakho le-imeyili
sizokuthumela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha.
auth.forgotPassword.cardText: Sizokuthumela iziqondiso ozidingayo ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho.
auth.forgotPassword.infoValidEmail: Ikheli lilungile. Ukuthunyelwa kwesixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha kuzatholakala uma isevisi yokuqinisekisa isiqalile.
auth.forgotPassword.helpText: Xhumana neqembu lethu losizo, silapha ukukusiza.
auth.forgotPassword.helpAlertMessage: Iqembu lethu losizo lizokuphendula ngokushesha okukhulu.
anonymous.mode.activeSubtitle: Iphrofayela yakho ihlala inganxuswanga nobuwena kuyilapho le modi isebenza.
anonymous.mode.nothingKeptSubtitle: Lolu lwazi alunxuswanga neprofayela yakho engaziwa.
anonymous.mode.appLockText: Ikhodi ye-PIN noma i-biometrics lapho uvula i-AWA
anonymous.mode.disableText: Ukuze uphume kumodi engaziwa, ungadala i-akhawunti futhi uxhumanise ikheli le-imeyili noma i-ID.
anonymous.mode.pitchSubtitle: Jabulela isikhala sakho se-AWA ngaphandle kokuxhumanisa ubuwena neprofayela yakho.
anonymous.mode.identityPrivateSubtitle: Ulwazi olungakubona aludingeki ukuze usebenzise le modi.
anonymous.mode.privacyRowAccount: Ayikho i-akhawunti ye-Google noma ye-Apple exhunyiwe
anonymous.mode.infoText: Ezinye izici ze-akhawunti, ukuvumelanisa noma ukubuyisa zingase zikhawulelwe kumodi engaziwa.
anonymous.mode.recommendedProtectionText: Uzokwazi ukuvikela ukufinyelela ku-AWA nge-PIN yakho noma i-biometrics.
anonymous.limitations.title: Ngaphambi kokuqhubeka
anonymous.limitations.subtitle: Kumodi engaziwa, ezinye izici ezihlobene ne-akhawunti zizokhawulelwa noma zingatholakali.
anonymous.limitations.recoveryText: Ngaphandle kwekheli le-imeyili elixhunyiwe, ukubuyisa ukufinyelela ku-akhawunti yakho kungakhawulelwa.
anonymous.limitations.syncText: Enye idatha ingase ingavumelaniseki kwamanye amadivayisi akho.
anonymous.limitations.communicationsText: I-AWA ngeke ikwazi ukukuthumelela ama-imeyili ahlobene ne-akhawunti yakho engaziwa.
anonymous.limitations.securityText: Sincoma ukuvula ikhodi ye-PIN noma i-biometrics ukuvikela ukufinyelela ku-AWA.
anonymous.limitations.acknowledgeLabel: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi imodi engaziwa isebenza kanjani.
anonymous.creating.creatingSubtitle: I-AWA ilungisa isikhala sakho esiyimfihlo futhi inqamula iphrofayela yakho olwazini olukubonayo.
anonymous.creating.protectionSubtitle: I-AWA ilungisa isikhala sakho ngenkathi isebenzisa okuthandwayo kwakho kobumfihlo.
anonymous.creating.warning: Ungayivali i-app ngenkathi isikhala sakho silungiswa.
anonymous.success.title: Imodi engaziwa ivuliwe
anonymous.success.subtitle: Iphrofayela yakho manje ayixhumene nobuwena. Jabulela i-AWA unobumfihlo obuphelele.
anonymous.success.cardSubtitle: Ungavala imodi engaziwa noma inini ku-Bumfihlo nokuphepha.
anonymous.avatar.title: Yakha isithombe esifana nawe
anonymous.avatar.subtitle: Khetha nje isitayela nombala. Akudingeki isithombe sakho.
anonymous.avatar.infoText: Lesi sithombe sithatha isikhundla sesithombe sakho ngenkathi imodi engaziwa isebenza. Alukho isithombe sangempela esisetshenziswa kuphrofayela yakho.
appLock.title: Isikhala sakho siyavikelwa
appLock.subtitle: Qinisekisa ukuze ufinyelele isikhala sakho siqu.
appLock.biometricAreaText: Sebenzisa i-biometrics ephephile yedivayisi yakho ukuvula i-AWA.
pinSetup.confirmIdentitySubtitle: Faka i-PIN yakho yamanje ukuze uvale ukuvikelwa.
pinSetup.verifyIdentitySubtitle: Qinisekisa ubuwena ngaphambi kokukhetha i-PIN entsha.
pinSetup.createSubtitle: Khetha i-PIN yezinombolo ezingu-{{length}} ukuvikela isikhala sakho se-AWA.
pinSetup.footerNote: I-PIN yakho ihlala ivikelekile endaweni yokugcina ephephile yale divayisi.
pinConfirm.title: Qinisekisa i-PIN yakho
pinConfirm.subtitle: Yifake okwesibili ukuze uqinisekise.
pinManagement.title: Ikhodi ye-PIN
faceIdSetup.noCapability: Ayikho indlela ye-biometrics esethiwe kule divayisi.
faceIdSetup.subtitleAvailable: Vikela ukufinyelela ku-AWA nge-biometrics ephephile yedivayisi yakho.
faceIdSetup.secureVerificationText: I-AWA isebenzisa kuphela ibhokisi le-biometrics lemvelo ledivayisi yakho. Ayikho idatha ye-biometrics egcinwa ku-app.
privacySecurity.title: Ubumfihlo nokuphepha
privacySecurity.subtitle: Idatha yakho, ubumfihlo bakho, ukukhetha kwakho 💜
privacySecurity.introText: Phatha ubumfihlo bedatha yakho futhi ukhethe ukuvikelwa okukufanele.
privacySecurity.discreetAppearanceSubtit: Igama nesithonjana se-app esikrinini sakho sasekhaya
privacySecurity.dataManagementSubtitle: Buka, thumela, noma susa idatha yakho
privacySecurity.footerInfo:
Izilungiselelo zakho zobumfihlo zihlala zisemandleni akho.
Ungazishintsha noma inini.
dataPrivacy.management.storageCount_one: Isikhala sokugcina sasekhaya esingu-{{count}} sisetshenziswa kule divayisi okwamanje.
dataPrivacy.management.storageCount_othe: Izikhala zokugcina zasekhaya ezingu-{{count}} zisetshenziswa kule divayisi okwamanje.
dataPrivacy.management.exportDescription: Yakha ikhophi ye-JSON ngemenyu yokwabelana ephephile.
dataPrivacy.management.deletionInfoMessa: Ukuze ususe yonke into, sebenzisa u-"Susa i-akhawunti yami" kusikrini esedlule.
dataPrivacy.deleteAccount.warningText: Yonke idatha ye-AWA egcinwe kule divayisi izosuswa unomphela.
discreetLauncher.title: Ukubukeka okuthulile
discreetLauncher.subtitle: Khetha ukuthi i-AWA ibukeke kanjani esikrinini sakho sasekhaya
discreetLauncher.infoCard: Lokhu kushintsha kuphela igama nesithonjana se-app esikrinini sakho sasekhaya. Idatha yakho nokuvikelwa kwayo (ikhodi ye-PIN, i-biometrics, ukufihlwa) kuhlala kunjalo, noma ngabe ukhetha obuphi ubuwena.
discreetLauncher.loadError: Ayikwazi ukufundwa indlela yamanje yokubukeka okwamanje.
discreetLauncher.discreetDescription: Ibukeka njenge-app yeagenda engathathi hlangothi, ngaphandle kwanoma yikuphi ukubhekisela ku-AWA
discreetLauncher.unsupportedVendor: Lesi sici sikhawulelwe yi-launcher yefoni yakho.
discreetLauncher.noteDelay: Isithonjana esisha singathatha imizuzwana embalwa ukuvela kuye ngokuthi yi-launcher yakho ye-Android.
discreetLauncher.switchDiscreetBody: I-app izobonakala ngegama elithi “Agenda” nesithonjana esingathathi hlangothi esikrinini sakho sasekhaya. Idatha nezilungiselelo zakho zizohlala zinjalo.
discreetLauncher.switchAwaBody: I-app izobonakala futhi ngegama nesithonjana sayo se-AWA.
discreetLauncher.errorModalBody: Ayikwazi ukushintsha ukubukeka kwe-app okwamanje. Ubuwena bakho bamanje abushintshanga. Zama futhi kamuva.
discreetLauncher.unsupportedVendorModalB: Ukushintsha isithonjana akusekelwa kule foni. Lesi sici sikhawulelwe yi-launcher yedivayisi yakho. Ubuwena bakho bamanje abushintshanga.
privateAccess.title: Isikhala esiyimfihlo
privateAccess.subtitle: Isikhala sakho, sakho wedwa
privateAccess.privacyCardText: Lonke ulwazi lwakho luhlala luvikelekile kudivayisi yakho.
securitySetup.heroSubtitle: Khetha ukuvikelwa ongathanda ukukuvula. Ungashintsha lezi zilungiselelo noma inini.
securitySetup.pinDescription: Khiya i-AWA lapho uyivula ngekhodi yakho siqu.
securitySetup.biometricsDescription: Sebenzisa isigxivizo somunwe noma ukubonwa kobuso kwedivayisi yakho.
securitySetup.discreetNotificationsDescr: Fihla imininingwane ebucayi ekubukeni kuqala kwezaziso zakho.
securitySetup.infoText: Lezi zilungiselelo ziyagcinwa ukuvikela ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwe-AWA futhi zingashintshwa kamuva.
privacyScreen.title:
Ubumfihlo bakho
buza kuqala
privacyScreen.subtitle:
Ugcina ulawulo oluphelele lwedatha yakho.
Siyivikela esinyathelweni ngasinye.
privacyScreen.guarantees.noResaleDescrip: Idatha yakho ayithengiswa, ayidluliselwa noma isetshenziselwa izinjongo zebhizinisi.
privacyScreen.guarantees.fullControlDesc: Ugcina ulawulo lolwazi lwakho nokuthi lusetshenziswa kanjani, njalo.
privacyScreen.guarantees.noExportDescrip: Idatha yakho siqu ayithunyelwa ngaphandle kwesevisi.
privacyScreen.guarantees.encryptedDescri: Ulwazi olubucayi luyavikelwa futhi idatha yobuwena ayaziwa.
privacyScreen.commitmentNoExport: Ayikho idatha yakho siqu ethunyelwa ngaphandle.
privacyScreen.commitmentNoInternalAccess: Akukho ukufinyelela kwangaphakathi okuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwemisebenzi edingekile futhi ephephile.
privacyScreen.commitmentIdentityEncrypte: Idatha yobuwena, njengegama lakho, ifihlwe futhi ayaziwa.
privacyScreen.freedomText: Ungashintsha okuthandayo kwakho nomaucele ukususwa kwedatha yakho noma inini kuzilungiselelo.
premium.sheet.introSubtitleAvailable: Vula amathuluzi acebisa ukulandelela kwakho kwansuku zonke.
premium.sheet.introSubtitleUnavailable: Hlola amathuluzi ahlelelwe ukucebisa ukulandelela kwakho kwansuku zonke.
premium.sheet.planSubtitleAvailable: Shintsha ukukhetha kwakho ngokukhululeka ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
premium.sheet.planSubtitleUnavailable: Amaplani angezansi abonakaliswa ukuze ubone kuphela — akukho ukuthenga okungenzeka okwamanje.
premium.sheet.securityTextAvailable: Ukuthenga kwakho nezibhekelo zakho kuzophathwa yi-Google Play noma i-App Store.
premium.sheet.securityTextUnavailable: Akukho nkokhelo ecelwayo ngenkathi izibhekelo zingakatholakali.
premium.sheet.activeSubtitle: Siyabonga ngokusekela i-AWA — jabulela wonke amathuba e-Premium.
premium.sheet.footerDisclaimer: Akukho ukuthenga okungenzeka okwamanje futhi akukho nkokhelo ezocelwa.
premium.sheet.benefits.exportsDescriptio: Yakha kalula imibiko yakho ye-PDF ne-CSV.
premium.sheet.benefits.advancedStatistic: Hlaziya intuthuko yakho phakathi nezinyanga ezi-3, ezi-6 nezi-12.
premium.sheet.benefits.unlimitedHistoryD: Thola yonke idatha yakho ngaphandle komkhawulo.
premium.sheet.feedback.unavailable: Akukho ukuthenga okuzovulwa kuze kuxhunywe uhlelo lokukhokha.
premium.sheet.feedback.subscribeError: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhashana.

premium.providerError: I-AWA Premium ayikatholakali kule divayisi. Zama futhi kamuva.
personalInformation.title: Ulwazi lwakho siqu
personalInformation.subtitle: Phatha ulwazi lwakho oluyisisekelo 🌸
personalInformation.intro: Lolu lwazi lusetshenziselwa ukwenza okuhlangenwe nakho kwakho ku-AWA kube kwakho siqu.
personalInformation.infoCardText:
Ungashintsha lolu lwazi noma inini.
Ezinye izinguquko zingase zithinte izibikezelo zakho.
personalInformation.invalidPhone: Faka inombolo yocingo yamazwe omhlaba evumelekile.
